title: Explore your journey
description: The incident map and walking-route comparisons are being developed. This preview does not access your location.
estimateDescription: AI classifications, hotspots, and route indicators will be estimates. No route can be guaranteed safe.

map.title: Reported incident areas
map.areaApproximate: This area is approximate. It never shows the exact place an incident was reported.
map.legendDescription: Each shaded area covers a place where several incidents were reported. Areas are approximate and never show an exact incident location.
map.suppressed_one: {{count}} area is not shown because too few reports were available.
map.suppressed_other: {{count}} areas are not shown because too few reports were available.
map.emptyDescription: This does not mean the area is safe. It means there is not enough reported information to show a pattern.
map.disclaimer: These areas show where incidents were reported, not where harassment actually occurs. Reporting is uneven, so busy areas may show more reports.
map.loadFailed: Reported areas could not be loaded. Please try again.

confidence.high: The AI read these reports clearly
confidence.moderate: The AI was moderately sure of these reports
confidence.low: The AI was unsure of these reports, so this area counts for less

planner.title: Plan a walking journey
planner.hintOrigin: Tap the map to set your starting point, or use your current location.
planner.hintDestination: Tap the map to set where you are going.
planner.locationDenied: Location permission was declined. You can still set your start point by tapping the map.
planner.locationUnavailable: Your location could not be determined. You can set your start point by tapping the map.

evidence.insufficient: Not enough reports to show a pattern
evidence.limited: Based on a small number of reports
evidence.moderate: Based on a moderate number of reports

routes.title: Compare walking routes
routes.noReportedIssues: No reported issues along this route
routes.noAlternativeDescription: No reasonable alternative avoided more reported areas, so only the fastest route is shown.
routes.loadFailed: Routes could not be compared. Please try again.
routes.disclaimer: Route comparisons are estimates based on reported incidents. No route is guaranteed to be safe. Use your own judgement.
